BiblicalUsage: zan means sort. In Daniel 3:5 we read, "That at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, dulcimer, and all kinds of musick..." It appears again in Daniel 3:7: "Therefore at that time, when all the people heard the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery..."
TheologicalSignificance: zan is sort, and what I take from it is that God speaks plainly, so I should listen plainly too.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
